details: US President Donald Trump announced a temporary halt to "Project Freedom," an operation aimed at guiding commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. This decision comes as "great progress" has reportedly been made towards a comprehensive agreement with Iran, and following requests from countries like Pakistan. Despite the pause, the blockade of the strait remains in full effect. Iran, for its part, has denied recent attack claims by the UAE and condemned the UAE's cooperation with "hostile parties," while affirming its commitment to ensuring safe transit through the Strait of Hormuz with new procedures. The ongoing tensions and the status of the Strait of Hormuz continue to be a significant factor influencing global financial markets and oil prices.
title: US Pauses "Project Freedom" in Strait of Hormuz Amidst Iran Deal Progress

details: Global financial markets saw a "risk-on" rally overnight, with gains across Asian, European, and US futures markets. This shift in sentiment is attributed to renewed optimism surrounding a potential ceasefire in the ongoing war with Iran, which has been a primary driver of market volatility since late February 2026. The conflict, particularly the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, has significantly impacted global oil and natural gas supply chains, leading to dramatic swings in oil prices and raising concerns about inflation and stagflation. Despite the rally, the war continues to weigh on the global economy, and geopolitical headlines move markets daily.
title: Global Markets Experience Rally Amidst Iran War Volatility and Ceasefire Hopes

details: The United Nations has welcomed the recent ceasefire announcement between Ukraine and Russia, a development that could ease broader geopolitical tensions. Concurrently, the UN has called on Israel to release two members of a Gaza aid flotilla, highlighting ongoing concerns about humanitarian access and security in the region. German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul also cautioned Israel against escalating the conflict in southern Lebanon. Reports from the UN indicate a surge in security incidents and civilian casualties in Ukraine despite the ceasefire.
title: UN Welcomes Ukraine-Russia Ceasefire, Expresses Concern Over Gaza Tensions
